# `accountant` commands

## `accountant add`

Make a member of this company its external accountant, the anchor's External Accountant user: they read everything, and write only adjusting journal entries (`journal post`, correcting or voiding only their own), reclassifications (`accountant reclassify`), review marks (`accountant mark-entry`, `accountant reviewed-through`) and notes, all dated on or before `through`, the end of the review period. Everything else they try is refused, and every change is attributed to them. The user must be a person holding the standard role on the company (no admin, as the anchor's External Accountant). Run again to move the period end. A person's step: an agent is refused.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | company |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/accountant.add` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow accountant add jlee --through 2026-09-30 --note "Q3 review" --reason "Q3 review" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "accountant add", "input": {"user": "jlee", "through": "2026-09-30", "note": "Q3 review"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | `USER` | string | yes | no | — | Username or user id of a person holding the standard role on this company (no admin, as the anchor's External Accountant).; minimum length 1; maximum length 64 |
| `through` | `--through` | string | yes | no | — | End of the review period, YYYY-MM-DD: the accountant posts only on or before it.; minimum length 10; maximum length 10 |
| `note` | `--note` | string \| null | no | yes | null | What the engagement is, such as 2026 year-end review. |

## `accountant reclassify`

Move an amount an entry posted from one account to another, as the anchor's Client Data Review reclassifies: an adjusting journal entry dated on the entry's date (or `date`) takes the amount (all of it by default) out of from_account and into to_account; the entry itself is not rewritten, so its history stands. The external accountant's, in these books or in an accountant's copy.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/accountant.reclassify` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow accountant reclassify 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --from-account "Office Supplies" --to-account "Repairs and Maintenance" --amount 120.00 --reason "Repairs booked to office" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "accountant reclassify", "input": {"transaction": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV", "from_account": "Office Supplies", "to_account": "Repairs and Maintenance", "amount": "120.00"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction` | `TRANSACTION` | string | yes | no | — | Id of the entry whose amount is moved (any posted document).; minimum length 1; maximum length 26 |

## `accountant remove`

End a member's external accountant designation; their membership is unchanged. A person's step.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | company |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/accountant.remove` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow accountant remove jlee --reason "Review finished" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
